configuration.title: Git Log
config.pullStrategy.description: Strategy used by the Pull button. Explicit Pull (Fast-forward only / Merge / Rebase) actions always override this setting.
config.currentLineBlameEnabled.descripti: Show author, relative time, and commit information after the active editor line. Uncommitted edit times are tracked from document changes and retained in workspace state. Automatically suppressed while VS Code's built-in Git blame editor decoration is enabled.
config.lineHistoryContextLines.descripti: Number of unchanged lines shown above and below changes in current-line history. The tracked Git history remains limited to the current line.
config.repositoriesScanDepth.description: Maximum directory depth used when discovering nested repositories.
config.repositoriesExclude.description: Glob patterns excluded from repository discovery.
config.maxDiffFileBytes.description: Maximum historical file size opened in the built-in text diff editor.
config.debugConsoleEntries.description: Maximum number of recent Git commands kept in memory for the Git Console. Set to 0 to disable recording.
config.debugConsoleVerbose.description: Record and display full, redacted Git arguments in the Git Console. Off by default so user-supplied search terms are not retained in memory.
config.pullStrategy.enumFfOnly.descripti: Fast-forward only; fail when the branches have diverged.
config.pullStrategy.enumRebase.descripti: Rebase the current branch onto the upstream branch.
config.protectedBranches.description: Branches where force push and rewriting already-pushed commits are blocked. Set to an empty array to disable all guards.
